name: St. Francois County, MO
findings: St. Francois County has 158 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Francois County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in St. Francois County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
